description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git merge and rename behaviors with large rename matrices. It sets up test repositories, performs rename operations, and verifies merge outcomes.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts from 1 up to a specified number, printing each number.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expecting success (assumed to be provided by the testing framework).

methods.name: make_text
methods.description: Generates textual content for files, used in creating test data for rename operations.

methods.name: test_rename
methods.description: Performs a series of rename and merge tests with varying rename limits, simulating layered file renames and merges in Git.
